sloka: मांसानि च समृष्टानि फलानि विविधानि च ।रामस्याभ्यवहारार्थं किङ्करास्तूर्णमाहरन् ।। ७.४२.१९ ॥
transliteration: māṁsāni ca samṛṣṭāni phalāni vividhāni ca ।rāmasyābhyavahārārthaṁ kiṅkarāstūrṇamāharan ।। 7.42.19 ॥

translations.english: Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, made her drink, just as Indra makes Shachi drink, and there were well-prepared meats and various fruits.
